... ... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Bindeshwar Kumar, Advocate  For the State : Mr. Shaheen Begum, APP  For the O.P. No.2 : Mr. Surj Bansh Roy, Advocate  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 4 19-09-2023

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and learned A.P.P. for the State.
2.
The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Section 498A/341/323/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Petitioner, who is husband of opposite party no2., is said to have ousted the opposite party no.2 from her matrimonial home in association of his family members over the dowry demand.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is an innocent person and has Patna High Court CR. MISC. No. 74085 of 2022(4) dt.19-09-2023 committed no offence.
Petitioner has neither made any dowry demand nor drove her out of her matrimonial home nor tormented her over the demand of dowry.

Learned counsel for the petitioner further submitted that petitioner is ready to make payment of Rs.5,000/- (Rupees Five Thousand) in second week of every succeeding month in the bank account of opposite party no.2, as per the details furnished by her Niraj @ Niraj Kumar @ Santoo @ Santoo ... vs The State Of Bihar on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76219113/
1 counsel.
5.

entities.text: Niraj @ Niraj Kumar @ Santoo @ Santoo ... vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In that view of the matter, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court below where the case is pending/successor Court in connection with Naubatpur P.S. Case No.202/2022, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.,
6.
It goes without saying that the aforesaid payment shall be subject to any order being passed in matrimonial, maintenance or any other collateral proceedings.
7. The present order, in any way, will preclude the parties to resolve the issue otherwise.

8. It is made clear that if the petitioner fails to Patna High Court CR. MISC. No. 74085 of 2022(4)
dt.19-09-2023 make payment on three consecutive dates, the learned court below will be at liberty to cancel the bail bond of the petitioner.
9. Accordingly, this application stands disposed of.

(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) Trivedi/-
